fact: The Standards Association of Zimbabwe's accreditations page lists ZWS ISO/IEC 27001:2022, on information security management systems, as a Zimbabwe Standard; the page's content is updated to February 2026, which is used as the date.
The ISO/IEC JTC 1 participation page, captured May 2026, lists SAZ of Zimbabwe as a participating member of JTC 1, Information technology.
ISO/IEC JTC 1 lists Zimbabwe among the P-members (participating members) of its 50th plenary, held 10-14 November 2025 in Chengdu.
ISO's member page lists the Standards Association of Zimbabwe as Zimbabwe's ISO member body, with 39 participating and 35 observing technical-committee memberships.

The Standards Association of Zimbabwe lists as published in Q1 2026 national standards that are ISO/IEC identicals on information technology, including ZWS ISO/IEC 23894:2023 (AI risk management), 22989:2022 (AI concepts), 27017:2015 (cloud security controls) and 27037:2012 (digital evidence).
ISO/IEC JTC 1 lists Zimbabwe among the P-members (participating members) of its 48th plenary, held 4-8 November 2024 in Seoul.
